claims.text: Integrating high-throughput CALPHAD with machine-learning optimization can rapidly identify refractory high-entropy alloy compositions.
The identified compositions can have improved strength, ductility, and lower weight compared with compositions produced by traditional trial-and-error methods.
High-throughput CALPHAD simulations can assess phase stability and thermo-kinetic properties of candidate RHEAs.
Gaussian-process regression combined with Bayesian optimization can iteratively refine candidate RHEA compositions.
The combined method promotes selection of compositions that form fine and stable phases or precipitates.
Fine and stable phases or precipitates facilitate enhanced strength.
Fine and stable phases or precipitates facilitate enhanced ductility.
Optimized microstructures containing fine and stable phases or precipitates reduce overall alloy density.
Simulated phase stability and structure-property relationships can be used to predict favorable RHEA compositions.
Iterative machine-learning feedback refines the predicted favorable compositions.
The iterative refinement can yield a composition balancing increased strength, increased ductility, and lower weight.
RHEAs identified by the integrated method are expected to show statistically significant increases in tensile strength relative to conventionally designed RHEAs.
RHEAs identified by the integrated method are expected to show statistically significant increases in ductility relative to conventionally designed RHEAs.
RHEAs identified by the integrated method are expected to have lower weight than conventionally designed RHEAs.
The performance of the approach depends on the completeness and accuracy of thermodynamic databases.
The performance of the approach depends on the completeness and accuracy of machine-learning training data.
Sparse data for extreme compositions can limit the approach.
Preliminary evidence supports the potential of the integrated method.
The method may not generalize to all multi-principal-element systems.
The method is sensitive to inaccuracies in simulation or experimental data.
